item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:stop this procedure family and try a totally different action approach, pressure-based
target_meaning: stop this procedure family and try a totally different action approach, pressure-based
reading: Engineer signal to abandon current cure attempts and switch to a pressure-based tool family (board pressing, palm pressing) as a reset. Combines the ABORT convention (engineer-initiated reset after repeated ineffs) with a family hint using one of the accepted family codes.

item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:switch to a procedure family reset, sound-based
target_meaning: switch to a procedure family reset, sound-based
reading: Family reset hint: switch cure approach to sound-based tools (bell, hum/voice tone, whistle). Sent by engineer after 2 ineffs at stage 1 to broadly redirect the tool family.

item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:switch to a procedure family reset, pressure-based
target_meaning: switch to a procedure family reset, pressure-based
reading: Family reset hint: switch to pressure-based tools (board pressed against faces, palm pressure, sandwiching). Broad family redirect after repeated failures.

item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:stop this procedure family and try a totally different action approach, sound-based
target_meaning: stop this procedure family and try a totally different action approach, sound-based

item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:switch to a procedure family reset, light-based
target_meaning: switch to a procedure family reset, light-based
reading: Family reset hint: switch to light-based tools (dim lamp / bright lamp positioned around Veyru).
The bright lamp tool — parenthetical (b) marks brightness variant of the lamp, as opposed to lamp(d) for dim. From the engineer's tool-shorthand list locked early in negotiation.
The dim lamp tool — parenthetical (d) marks the dim brightness variant of the lamp. Paired with lamp(b) bright.

Lamp used at moderate intensity — combines the lamp tool with the 'mod' intensity keyword from the locked intensity set (soft/mod/firm/hard/brief). Decodable by composition but the intensity slot for lamp was expressed as (d)/(b) brightness variants in our lockdown rather than soft/mod/firm, so this form was never actually negotiated.
Repetition count: 3 times. From the locked REPS shorthand (x1, x3, x5) meaning 'repeat N times'. Used for bell strikes, cycles, etc.

item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:the same symptom pattern again, one time
target_meaning: the same symptom pattern again, one time
reading: Composed from 'again' (echo previous symptom description with the 'again' tag, e.g. 'drift again') plus 'x1' (once). Would read as 'same as before, one time' — but 'again' was locked as a symptom-report tag, not a REPS modifier, and it doesn't naturally combine with a count. Decodable by morpheme composition but not a negotiated form.

item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:the same symptom pattern again, three times
target_meaning: the same symptom pattern again, three times
reading: Composed from 'again' + 'x3' — would read as 'same symptom as before, three times' or 'repeat previous procedure 3 times'. Same issue as 'again x1': 'again' was a symptom-echo tag, not something that combined with reps. Decodable but not negotiated.
Repetition count: once / one time. From the locked REPS shorthand family (x1, x3, x5). Used for single strikes or single passes.
